subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: For Feishu Bitable table-level operations after app replacement, should OpenClaw stay on app-credential bot auth with better setup diagnostics, or add a user-auth/token path for the affected table APIs?
rationale: Current source supports only appId/appSecret SelfBuild clients for Bitable tools, while changing auth mode or account precedence affects plugin config, credentials, and upgrade behavior that automation should not decide without Feishu owner intent.

options.title: Collect live error, then choose narrow fix
options.body: Ask for the Feishu response code/body/log_id and use it to decide whether this is a permission/setup diagnostic bug or a real auth-mode gap.

options.title: Design user-auth Bitable support
options.body: Treat table-level operations as requiring a new user-auth path and define token storage, setup, and migration expectations before implementation.

options.title: Fold only the misrouting case into the open account-routing issue
options.body: If the reporter confirms this happens only on non-inbound multi-account turns, track that part under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96657 and leave app-replacement auth evidence separate.

recommendation.title: Collect live error, then choose narrow fix
recommendation.body: Ask for the Feishu response code/body/log_id and use it to decide whether this is a permission/setup diagnostic bug or a real auth-mode gap.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies m1heng as the Feishu/Lark plugin community contact, and this is a plugin-owned auth/account behavior choice.
